description: A warm, gentle woman in her forties with a soft, clear, mid-pitched voice. She is a native Polish speaker with a natural standard Polish accent. She prays aloud calmly and sincerely at a natural, unhurried conversational pace, with gentle natural intonation, reverent but not slow and not theatrical.
ref_text: Chwała Ojcu i Synowi, i Duchowi Świętemu. Jak była na początku, teraz i zawsze, i na wieki wieków. Amen.
